negative_reviews.author: Gary Cairns
negative_reviews.text: Went in for lunch with my wife. First time we've been. Ordered the soft shell crab rolls and unfortunately the meat was obviously spoiled. Only had one mouth full. The rainbow sushi roll we got also tasted of fish past it's best. The issue was handled well by the staff but I don't think I'll be going back. Update - reduced my rating to one star. My wife now has food poisoning. Will be reporting to the authorities

negative_reviews.author: Regan Roberts
negative_reviews.text: I got SEVERE FOOD POISONING after eating here last Wednesday. The ramen I got should have been served piping hot. I'm now on day four of being sick with diarrhea, nausea, fatigue, and stomach cramps. I have filed a complaint with the Aberdeen City Council. AVOID THIS RESTAURANT AT ALL COSTS!!!
